Composition order, opposite rings, every matrix entry and index, every summand, scalar action, power and domain/codomain remain as in the retained original proof. Code-block continuation after the summation sign is kept in the same displayed expression.
presentation_refinements: End, Cent and dim are typeset as operators.
Whitespace introduced during Unicode command conversion does not become a large mathematical gap.
The ordered-product coordinate polynomial retains its complete summand after the sum sign.
The two endomorphism-ring equalities may wrap at their original separating comma.
An empty TeX group separates the display row break from the literal field-degree bracket [C:k], preventing it from being parsed as optional spacing. No mathematical token changed.
